en: \bI'm afraid to go in. It's just so large.

en: \bThe Tower of Mastery is our gym. It is also a special place for Mega Evolution.

en: \bKorrina recently returned. She seemed very excited.
it: \bKorrina è tornata da poco. Sembrava molto entusiasta.

en: \rI want to Mega Evolve my Dustox one day. I hope I can.
it: \rUn giorno voglio far megaevolvere il mio Dustox. Spero di riuscirci.

id: \bI've traveled across Kanto before. I found it very thrilling. Except for this one trip where a cruise I was on was ambushed by criminals. A child saved us.
en: \bI've traveled across Kanto before. I found it very thrilling. Except for this one trip where a cruise I was on was ambushed by criminals. A child saved us.
it: \bHo già viaggiato per Kanto in passato. L'ho trovato molto emozionante. Tranne quella volta in cui la nave da crociera su cui mi trovavo fu assalita da dei criminali. Ci salvò un ragazzino.
